description: This file defines structures, macros, and function declarations for managing protection metadata related to media streaming, specifically for use with GStreamer. It includes definitions for GstRialtoProtectionData and GstRialtoProtectionMetadata structures, as well as external function declarations for retrieving type and info metadata.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Function to get the GType for the protection metadata, used in GObject type system.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Function to retrieve metadata information for the protection metadata.
